ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: German Anti-Money Laundering Act (Geldwäschegesetz, GwG), in particular Sections 3, 12, 20, 21, 23, 24 and 47; German Commercial Register Code (Handelsgesetzbuch, HGB) Sections 8-13; German Limited Liability Companies Act (Gesetz betreffend die Gesellschaften mit beschränkter Haftung, GmbHG); Transparency Register implementing decrees (Transparenzregister-Verordnung); EU AML Directives IV and V as transposed.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national identity card for each beneficial owner and designated managing director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing passport authority (home country) and German notary certifying the copy
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization for foreign documents

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing for corporate shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign company registry in the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of no criminal record (Führungszeugnis or equivalent) for each managing director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Federal Office of Justice (Bundesamt für Justiz) in Germany, or the general director's home country police authority for foreign nationals
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization for foreign-issued certificates

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft articles of association (Gesellschaftsvertrag) certified and notarized as a notarial deed
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic notarial deed; no apostille required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP screening under Section 1(19) GwG and FATF Recommendation 12; mandatory screening against OFAC consolidated SDN list, UN Security Council consolidated list, EU autonomous sanctions (EU Regulation 269/2014 and EU Regulation 833/2014), and German national sanctions list under the German Foreign Trade and Payments Ordinance (Außenwirtschaftsverordnung – AWV). Screening is required at customer onboarding, upon material changes to beneficial ownership, and during continuous business-relationship monitoring. Adverse hits trigger enhanced due diligence, beneficial-ownership disclosure, and, where necessary, preliminary suspension and reporting to the German Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: German Commercial Register (Handelsregister) – common register portal operated by Bundesanzeiger Verlag on behalf of national courts; online access at www.handelsregister.de and www.unternehmensregister.de
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in Latin script; there is no mandatory German-language requirement for trade names, but the statutory legal form suffix 'Gesellschaft mit beschränkter Haftung' or the commonly used abbreviation 'GmbH' is required. Names must be visually distinctive within the German Commercial Register, must not be misleading about the business or legal form, and must not contain non-Latin characters in the registered trade name. For foreign language or Chinese-script brand elements, an official transliteration into Latin letters is required for registration, although non-script stylization may be used as a trade dress.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a rejection of the proposed name by the local Commercial Register court (Amtsgericht), the founder or the notary may submit a revised name within the same reservation window. If the objection is to the reasoning of the rejection, a formal administrative appeal (Beschwerde) may be filed to the competent District Court (Landgericht) in accordance with Sections 58 to 70 of the German Act on Proceedings in Family Matters and in Matters of Non-Contentious Jurisdiction (FamFG). The appeal must be filed within one month from service of the rejection, can be accompanied by a supplementary written statement, and, where possible, a new name application should be filed simultaneously to preserve the preferred incorporation timeline. If the District Court also rejects the appeal, the decision may be challenged by a further, limited appeal (Rechtsbeschwerde) to the Federal Court of Justice (Bundesgerichtshof) only if authorized under statutory grounds.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A fully virtual office without a verifiable physical German address is not permissible for registering a GmbH with the Commercial Register. A registered office (Sitz) and physical German business address (Geschäftsanschrift) must be provided and served for legal documents. Virtual office providers are generally accepted only when they supply a real street address in Germany, a named mailbox, and forwarding of summons and court documents. For this fast-casual food franchise master licensing business, the German trade and tax authorities expect actual commercial substance, including decision-making management, accounting records, and a reachable operational or administrative contact point in Germany. A virtual office may be used for the administrative address during the pre-operational stage only if the managing director maintains a domestic address and full access to corporate books.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: GmbH (German Limited Liability Companies Act) §§ 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11, 19, 41; Commercial Code (HGB) §§ 8, 106, 108; Handelsregisterverordnung (HRV).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Commercial Register (Handelsregister) maintained by the local District Court (Amtsgericht); notarial submission by the public notary.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized foundation deed (Gesellschaftsvertrag) and application for registration (Anmeldung zur Eintragung) submitted electronically by the notary.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Standard GmbH requires share capital of EUR 25,000 and at least EUR 12,500 paid-up on formation. Cash contributions must be deposited in a blocked/escrow bank account in the company's name before registration; contribution in kind requires full valuation and disclosure.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that each attending shareholder irrevocably subscribes to the share quota opposite its name, assumes full contribution liability under § 19 GmbHG, and waives no part of the capital requirement. RESOLVED, that the registered office is fixed at the address stated in the articles and that the corporate purpose of operating self-serve Malatang broth-bowl restaurants is approved. RESOLVED, that [full name] is appointed Managing Director with sole representation authority and is authorized to execute all legal filings before the Commercial Register, tax authorities, and licensing boards. RESOLVED, that the Managing Director shall open the company's bank account, supervise the block of paid-up capital, and take every step needed to complete the statutory formation and obtain trade and food licenses. All preceding resolutions are effective immediately unless otherwise stated.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name clearance and draft articles of association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Notarin/Notar) with Commercial Register name-availability search.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a notary, perform a name search in the Handelsregister and Unternehmensregister, verify no conflicting trademark or corporate name, and draft the Gesellschaftsvertrag including the business-object clause for fast-casual self-serve Malatang restaurants and capital provisions.
required_dossiers: Passport or national ID of each founding shareholder
Certified German translation of non-German identity documents
Draft company name and proposed business object
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is rejected or conflicts with an existing mark, select an alternative suffix or locality identifier and resubmit for clearance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open blocked capital account and deposit minimum paid-up capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: German commercial bank or notary escrow account (Anderkonto).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a restricted account in the name of the GmbH-in-formation, deposit at least EUR 12,500, and obtain a Sperrvermerk/blocked-capital confirmation stating that funds are irrevocably at the company's disposal subject to registration.
required_dossiers: Draft notarized articles or foundation protocol
Personal identification of shareholders and designated Managing Director
Bank account application and entity formation cover letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank delays the confirmation due to KYC queries, provide updated identification or residence proof, or switch to another eligible bank; never unblock the capital before registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute notarized deed and first board resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Notarin/Notar); registration court is addressed through the notary.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct the constitutive meeting before the notary, execute the articles of association, adopt the first board resolution covering share subscription, registered office, and Managing Director appointment, and authorize the notary to file the application with the Commercial Register.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or expected court review questions the object clause or capital adequacy, correct the articles or submit a supplementary valuation letter and re-execute the deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial register filing and registration certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary submits the electronic registration application to the competent Amtsgericht. After review by the Rechtspfleger, the GmbH is entered and published in the Unternehmensregister and the Bundesanzeiger.
required_dossiers: Execution declaration on compliance with legal conditions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a rejection decree, file an Erinnerung or Beschwerde, or correct the defect and resubmit within the statutory response window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Trade registration and post-formation tax enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Gewerbeamt (Trade Office), Finanzamt (Tax Office), and competent IHK chamber.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Gewerbeanmeldung, obtain the tax number via the Fragebogen zur steuerlichen Erfassung, register for VAT and EORI where needed, and enroll as employer with the social insurance data collection system and the IHK.
required_dossiers: Rented premises consent and lease agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Finanzamt queries the tax questionnaire, supply a detailed economic-activity description and opening operational income forecast, or request interim provisional VAT ID while the application is processed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Food business registration, hygienic licensing, and fire clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Gesundheitsamt / Lebensmittelüberwachungsamt (Health and Food Inspection Authority) and Feuerwehr (Fire Department).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register as a food business at least six weeks before opening, submit premises and flow-of-goods plans, HACCP self-checking manual, staff § 43 IfSG health certificates, and obtain the trade/food operation permit and fire-safety clearance after inspection.
required_dossiers: Premises floor plan and kitchen ventilation layout
Fire safety certificate and structural load approvals
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the food authority issues objections, correct HACCP gaps, install a grease separator or required ventilation, and resubmit with a rectification certificate and amended plans.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Local Gewerbeamt (Trade Office) and Gesundheitsamt/Lebensmittelüberwachungsamt (Food Hygiene and Consumer Protection Office) under the state Ministry of Consumer Protection.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Gewerbeanmeldung (trade registration), Lebensmittelbetriebsregistrierung (food business registration) and, if serving prepared food on the premises, Gaststättengenehmigung/Erlaubnis.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Umweltbundesamt (Federal Environment Agency) and the lower environmental protection authority (Untere Umweltschutzbehörde) of the municipality.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category V – registration and notification only; no full EIA report (UVP) required under UVPG Annex 1 for small fast-casual food operations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater pH 6.5–9.5, COD ≤ 150 mg/L, BOD ≤ 25 mg/L, total fats ≤ 100 mg/L after DIN 4040 grease separator; kitchen exhaust grease < 0.15 mg/m³ and VOC within TA Luft thresholds; commercial waste separately collected, recycled and documented per GewAbfV.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance: Brandverhütungsanzeige with fire alarm/escape concept approved by the local Feuerwehr; structural clearance: compliance with building load and ventilation proof under Bauordnung (LBauO); workplace clearance: DGUV V3 electrical test and occupational safety inspection by the competent Berufsgenossenschaft before first operation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Local competent tax office (Finanzamt) for corporate tax, trade tax administration, and VAT compliance; Federal Central Tax Office (Bundeszentralamt für Steuern, BZSt) for the German VAT identification number (USt-IdNr.). Tax registration questionnaire and electronic tax filings are generally processed through the ELSTER portal (Elektronische Steuererklärung), while VAT ID applications are submitted through the BZSt online service or the tax registration process.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1. Incorporate and register the GmbH with the competent commercial register and local trade office. 2. Submit the electronic tax registration questionnaire (Fragebogen zur steuerlichen Erfassung) through ELSTER to the competent Finanzamt. 3. Provide the articles of association, commercial-register details, registered office, directors, beneficial-owner information, business activities, expected turnover, banking information, and evidence of German business premises or taxable activities. 4. Obtain the German tax number (Steuernummer) issued by the Finanzamt for corporate tax, trade tax, and VAT filings. 5. Apply to the BZSt for a VAT identification number (USt-IdNr.) where intra-EU supplies, acquisitions, or cross-border services require it. 6. A foreign parent or foreign entity without a German establishment must appoint a German tax representative where required by the applicable filing structure and must register for German VAT if it makes taxable supplies in Germany that are not covered by the reverse-charge mechanism or a small-business exemption. 7. Update the Finanzamt and BZSt promptly when registered-office, director, ownership, business-activity, or VAT-liability information changes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: A GmbH is a separate taxable corporation and is generally subject to German corporate income tax and solidarity surcharge, together with municipal trade tax. Germany has no general United States-style check-the-box election for a GmbH. Available statutory mechanisms include VAT small-business treatment under Section 19 of the German VAT Act where the statutory turnover conditions are satisfied, election to waive the small-business treatment and apply ordinary VAT, VAT group treatment (Organschaft) where financial, economic, and organizational integration requirements are met, and corporate tax group treatment (ertragsteuerliche Organschaft) where statutory profit-transfer and other requirements are satisfied. German anti-hybrid mismatch rules under Sections 4k of the Income Tax Act and related provisions generally operate as mandatory limitation rules; they do not provide a general elective hybrid classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (Umsatzsteuer, VAT), supplemented by intra-EU VAT rules, import VAT, and reverse-charge mechanisms.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: There is generally no turnover threshold that permits an established German GmbH to avoid VAT registration for ordinary taxable business activities. The German small-business regime under Section 19 of the German VAT Act may apply if total domestic turnover did not exceed EUR 25,000 in the preceding calendar year and does not exceed EUR 100,000 in the current calendar year, subject to statutory conditions and the applicable effective-date rules. A business using the small-business regime generally does not charge VAT and cannot deduct input VAT. Special registration rules apply to non-established businesses, distance sales, platform transactions, intra-EU acquisitions, and supplies subject to reverse charge.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Germany does not currently operate a universal real-time VAT invoice-clearance system comparable to mandatory clearance models in certain other jurisdictions. From 1 January 2025, domestic businesses must be able to receive structured electronic invoices for domestic business-to-business transactions, subject to statutory exclusions. Mandatory issuance of structured electronic invoices for qualifying domestic B2B transactions is phased in: generally from 1 January 2027 for businesses exceeding the statutory prior-year turnover threshold and from 1 January 2028 for broader domestic B2B transactions, subject to transitional rules. Accepted structured formats include standards such as XRechnung and compatible ZUGFeRD formats meeting the legal requirements. Invoices must contain the required VAT particulars, be retained in a manner preserving authenticity and integrity, and be made available for tax audit. There is no general requirement for prior digital stamping or real-time API transmission to the tax authority, although electronic VAT filings, accounting records, and audit data may be required through ELSTER or electronic audit interfaces.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods from Germany to destinations outside the European Union may qualify for the German VAT exemption with input-tax deduction under the German VAT Act if the goods are transported or dispatched to a third country and the supplier can substantiate the export and the supplier-customer transaction. Proof generally requires customs or equivalent electronic export evidence, commercial documentation, transport records, and a consistent audit trail linking the invoice, goods, buyer, and export movement. Intra-EU supplies are generally exempt with input-tax deduction only where the customer is a qualifying VAT-identified taxable person in another EU Member State, the goods are transported to that Member State, and the supplier satisfies the statutory documentary and recapitulative-statement requirements. Services supplied to customers outside Germany are not automatically zero-rated; the place-of-supply rules must first establish that the service is outside the German VAT scope or qualifies for a specific exemption. Restaurant and catering services performed in Germany generally remain subject to German VAT, with the applicable rate depending on the nature of the supply and statutory food-service rules.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Electronic export declaration and customs export confirmation, including the exit result where applicable
Commercial invoice identifying the supplier, customer, goods, value, delivery terms, and VAT treatment
Transport evidence such as bill of lading, airway bill, CMR consignment note, courier record, or equivalent proof of dispatch
Packing list and inventory or delivery records sufficient to reconcile the exported goods
Purchase order, contract, customer correspondence, and payment evidence linking the supply to the export
Evidence of the customer's location and, for intra-EU supplies, the customer's valid EU VAT identification number
Accounting records and VAT return reconciliation supporting the zero-rated or exempt treatment

Inward-remittance or foreign-exchange evidence only where relevant to the transaction or requested by a competent authority; Germany has no general statutory requirement for an inward-remittance certificate as a universal export-VAT document
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Germany does not generally impose a universal 180-day foreign-exchange repatriation deadline as a condition for export VAT exemption. Export treatment may be denied or clawed back where the export, customer location, transport, or documentary evidence is missing, inconsistent, late, or false. The supplier may become liable for the output VAT that should have been charged, together with interest under the German Fiscal Code, correction of VAT returns, repayment of improperly recovered input VAT, and possible liability of responsible persons. Intentional or reckless false VAT declarations may constitute tax evasion or tax understatement under the German Fiscal Code, potentially resulting in criminal prosecution, fines, imprisonment for tax evasion, administrative penalties, denial of input-tax deductions, and enhanced audit measures. Invoices that improperly show VAT can create an independent VAT liability for the invoiced amount. Repeated non-compliance may also trigger late-filing penalties, compulsory assessment, suspension or review of VAT refunds, and joint or personal liability proceedings against directors where statutory conditions are met.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible for both capital and current accounts under EU regulations and German FX law. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are unrestricted, subject only to standard tax reporting and beneficial ownership disclosure.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender of export proceeds exists in Germany. Foreign currency receipts must be converted to euros for domestic accounting purposes within a reasonable timeframe, but no statutory timeline or conversion ratio is prescribed. Full documentation is required for AML and tax compliance.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMIs are feasible only through BaFin-licensed German banks or authorized fintechs. Cross-border EMI services remain subject to strict AML/KYC controls and may be restricted for certain payment categories.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors and authorized signatories must attend physical KYC interviews for corporate account opening; remote onboarding is not permitted for treasury or escrow accounts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership or source of funds linked to Chinese entities or nationals
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-funds certificates, board resolutions, licensing agreements, and evidence of legitimate business purpose to address foreign ownership and money laundering risks

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital via SWIFT MT103 wires with purpose code 'CAP' for equity or 'LOAN' for debt. Verification requires beneficial ownership proofs, board minutes, and bank references. Chinese source funds necessitate additional due diligence on legitimate business intent.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements via SWIFT MT103 for trade payments or Commercial Letters of Credit for secured transactions. All disbursements must reference specific contracts and use compliant purpose codes.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements (Jahresabschluss) - preparation, audit if applicable, and submission to Bundesanzeiger
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months after fiscal year-end for small companies; within 6 months for medium/large companies; submission to Bundesanzeiger within one month after preparation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Ordnungsgeld (administrative fine) from EUR 2,500 up to EUR 25,000; repeated non-compliance may lead to further fines and registration blocking

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Tax Return - Corporate Income Tax (Körperschaftsteuer), Trade Tax (Gewerbesteuer), and VAT (Umsatzsteuer) annual return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally 7 months after fiscal year-end (31 July); with tax advisor extension to 28 February of the second following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty (Verspätungszuschlag) up to 10% of assessed tax, minimum EUR 25 per month; late payment interest 0.5% per month

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Trade Tax Return (Gewerbesteuererklärung) - separate annual filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same as corporate income tax return: 7 months after fiscal year-end, extended to 28 February of second following year with advisor
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty as above; estimated assessment (Schätzung) possible

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally 7 months after fiscal year-end; extension as above
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty up to 10% of tax, minimum EUR 25 per month

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Transparency Register Annual Confirmation - notification of changes to beneficial owners
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 2 weeks of any change; annual confirmation not required if no change, but update mandatory upon change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to EUR 1,000,000 for serious violations; public warning possible

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Municipal Trade Registration Renewal (Gewerbeanmeldung) - only upon change or cessation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Upon commencement or change; no annual renewal required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to EUR 1,000 for failure to register

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Audit required if company exceeds two of three thresholds for two consecutive years: total assets > EUR 6,000,000; annual revenue > EUR 12,000,000; average employees > 50. Small companies (below thresholds) exempt from statutory audit but must prepare financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: German Commercial Code (Handelsgesetzbuch - HGB) for statutory financial statements; IFRS for consolidated financial statements if required

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: GmbH must maintain and update the Transparency Register with beneficial owner information. No annual confirmation required if no changes, but any change (shareholding transfers, ownership structure) must be reported within 2 weeks. Annual confirmation of accuracy is recommended as best practice. Failure to update triggers fines.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Gesellschafterliste) - filed with Commercial Register

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: EUR 300 - EUR 1,500 per year for registered office; additional EUR 500 - EUR 2,000 for corporate secretarial services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: EUR 5,000 - EUR 20,000 for small to medium GmbH; higher for larger or complex entities

stage_6.statutory_headline_rate: 15% Körperschaftsteuer + 5.5% Solidaritätszuschlag (effective CIT 15.825%) + municipal Gewerbesteuer (Hebesatz-dependent, avg. ~14-17%); combined effective burden ~29-33%
stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holidays; deductions available for trade tax add-back, investment incentives, and §8d KStG loss carryforward protection on qualifying acquisitions
